functions.name: entry
functions.summary: THE GAME LAUNCHER: reads pockets.ini's video-driver line, EXECs klogopok.exe (with /m<X> /t5 0, X derived from the driver char), then intro.exe, then loops EXECing game.exe (relaunching on non-zero exit code). Restores video mode and terminates on zero exit. See docs/launcher.md.
